question: The Swachh Bharat Abhiyaan is celebrated on which Indian National festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhi Jayanti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyaan** was launched on **2nd October 2014**, coinciding with **Gandhi Jayanti**, to honor Mahatma Gandhi’s vision of a clean and hygienic India.
 
• The campaign was initiated by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and aims to promote cleanliness, sanitation, and the elimination of open defecation across India.
 
• **Gandhi Jayanti**, celebrated annually on **October 2nd**, marks the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi and is observed as a national holiday in India.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi was a proponent of cleanliness and strongly believed in the principle of “Cleanliness is next to Godliness.” His teachings inspired the launch of this campaign.
 
• The date was chosen to align with Gandhi’s ideals of cleanliness and community hygiene, making it a symbolic occasion for the Swachh Bharat initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Objectives of Swachh Bharat Abhiyaan:**

 
 
• The campaign primarily aims to achieve a **clean and hygienic India** by **2nd October 2019**, marking the 150th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• Its focus includes the **elimination of open defecation** through the construction of toilets, promoting sanitation, managing waste, and encouraging behavioral changes.
 
• The mission was divided into two sub-missions: **Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban)** and **Swachh Bharat Mission (Rural)**, targeting urban and rural areas respectively.
 
• Various campaigns and initiatives like **Clean India Drives** and community participation were conducted to spread awareness and encourage active involvement.
 
 
 
• **Gandhi Jayanti:**
 
 
• **Gandhi Jayanti** is celebrated nationwide with various activities like prayer meetings, cultural events, and cleanliness drives honoring Mahatma Gandhi’s legacy.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi, born on **2nd October 1869**, is renowned for his principles of non-violence, truth, and social reforms.
 
• The day is observed as a **national holiday**, and events promoting peace and cleanliness take place across the country.
 
• It is also recognized globally as the **International Day of Non-Violence**, highlighting Gandhi’s influence on the world.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Swachh Bharat Abhiyaan:**
 
 
• Since its inception, the mission has achieved significant milestones, including the construction of over **100 million toilets**, making many areas **open defecation-free (ODF)**.
 
• The campaign has helped improve the overall **sanitation coverage** in India, with increased awareness about hygiene and cleanliness.
 
• It has also promoted **waste segregation**, recycling, and eco-friendly practices, contributing to a cleaner environment.
 
 
 
• **Other National Festivals in India:**
 
 
• **Independence Day:** Celebrated annually on **15th August**, marking India’s independence from British rule in 1947.
 
• **Republic Day:** Observed on **26th January**, commemorating the adoption of India’s Constitution in 1950.
 
• **New Year:** Celebrated globally on **1st January**, marking the beginning of a new year.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Swachh Bharat Abhiyaan’s Symbolic Launch:**

 
 
• The launch date, **October 2nd**, was deliberately chosen to honor Mahatma Gandhi’s lifelong commitment to cleanliness and sanitation.
 
• The campaign represents a tribute to Gandhi’s vision and aims to fulfill his dream of a clean India.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Gandhi Jayanti:**
 
 
• **Gandhi Jayanti** serves as a reminder of Mahatma Gandhi’s contributions to India’s independence and social reforms.
 
• It is an occasion to reflect on his teachings and implement his principles in daily life.
